payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how lexicons are compared through evaluations by crowds and experts, as well as the methodologies used for lexicon acquisition.

claims.text: Lexicon quality is assessed by comparing evaluations from crowds and expert linguists.
Crowdsourced lexicons can be more comprehensive and scalable compared to those created solely by experts.
The evaluation process includes filtering to ensure the quality of annotations from the crowd.
Comparisons with existing lexicons show moderate overlap, indicating a method of evaluation based on common terms.
